# WM Newsticker

> WordPress block plugin for animated news tickers: scroll, fade, slide and typing animations with manual headlines or the latest posts of a post type.

## Facts

- Version 1.4.7. Requires WordPress 5.9+ and PHP 7.4+ (header); CI runs PHP 8.1 to 8.3.
- Block `wm/newsticker` (dynamic, `block.json` API 3); REST route `wm-newsticker/v1/post-types` for the editor; WP-CLI `wp newsticker post-types | flush-cache | demodaten`.
- Filter `wm_newsticker_rendered_items`. WM Suite Hub spoke adapter.
- Pauses on hover; optional play/pause and previous/next buttons; respects `prefers-reduced-motion`. No pause on keyboard focus.
- No external requests, no cookies, no personal data. No accessibility conformity is claimed.
- Editor translated into German and Spanish; the PHP catalogs are mostly untranslated.

## Project structure

- `wm-newsticker.php` — main plugin file
- `block.json` — block metadata
- `src/index.js`, `src/frontend.js`, `src/editor.scss`, `src/style.scss` — sources; `build/` — compiled and versioned
- `includes/` — WP-CLI command, hub adapter
- `languages/` — `.pot`, `.po` / `.mo`, editor JSON translations
- `tests/` — standalone suite, mutation check, WordPress integration tests
